text:
alex.w: noticed a spike in GPU pod restarts in us-west-2, dashboard is missing per-GPU metrics, getting customer errors for dedicated pools
priya: seeing the same, autoscaler kept terminating nodes, looks like spot/preemptible churn + network flaps to the metadata endpoint
jorge: prometheus shows big gaps starting 2024-11-08T14:02Z, most scrape targets in monitoring namespace are UNKNOWN
emily: can we shift traffic off us-west-2 to us-east-1 for affected customers? we have capacity in shared pools but not enough reserved GPUs
sam: routing policy allows regional failover but Dedicated customers pinned to us-west-2. we'll need to evict or fall back to hosted models — that's a product decision
alex.w: paging @priya @jorge for immediate mitigation — we need visibility first. what metrics are missing?
priya: node_exporter metrics (node_cpu_seconds_total, nvidia_smi collector) are mostly absent. also kubelet /metrics endpoint timed out for several nodes
infra-bot: ALERT: GPU_Node_Flapping us-west-2 - 23 nodes reported NotReady in last 10m (severity: high)
metrics-bot: Incident: prometheus-scrape-failure detected for cluster=us-west-2 (missing series count -72%)
jorge: looks like prometheus-operator pod crashed when scraping a hung exporter; logs show OOMKilled in prometheus sidecar earlier
priya: quick check: `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -o wide` shows prometheus-* CrashLoopBackOff and loki-ingester has high memory
emily: can we restart prometheus pods to get the scrapes back? risk of losing short-term TS ingestion but we need live metrics for failover decisions
sam: do it. restart one replica at a time and watch scrape backlog. also throttle scrape targets to reduce memory pressure
alex.w: commands I ran: ```
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart statefulset/prometheus
kubectl -n monitoring scale statefulset/prometheus --replicas=1
```
priya: after restart, most node_exporter metrics came back but GPU exporter (nvidia-smi) still missing for some nodes — those nodes show kubelet network errors in journal
jorge: suspect network policy or route table churn in the us-west subnets during the outage window. Control plane looked healthy but some route advertisements timed out
emily: OK shifted non-dedicated routing for low-priority traffic to us-east-1. customers on Dedicated still impacted, sending comms now
sam: note: shifting increased token cost ~+14% because model fallbacks in hosted pool are larger models; need cost sign-off if sustained
alex.w: recording the observability gap: when prometheus crashed we lost 7–12m windows of per-GPU metrics, no fallback store, and traces for kubelet RPCs were sampled out. that made root-cause hunting slow
priya: immediate instrumentation fixes we can ship as hotfixes: 1) add scrape buffering (remote_write queue) 2) enable pushgateway for exporters that are flaky 3) increase scrape timeout for GPU exporter to 15s
jorge: and add synthetic GPU health probes per node (small workload that runs `nvidia-smi` and pushes a small metric) so we have an independent heartbeat even if exporter crashes
emily: will create customer-facing note. add an incident tag to the affected resources so billing can reconcile extra tokens/costs
sam: ops TODOs (short-term):
- restart prometheus one replica at a time (done)
- throttle scrape frequency for heavy exporters from 15s -> 30s (doing now)
- shift non-dedicated traffic to us-east-1 (done)
- create temporary autoscaler min increase for us-east to accept failover (in progress)

alex.w: longer-term instrumentation/action items:
- replicate prometheus remote_write to a second long-term TSDB region (owner: priy a)
- implement push-based fallback for GPU metrics and kubelet traces (owner: jorge)
- add synthetic probes + alert for lost exporter heartbeats (owner: emily)
- add a low-cardinality aggregated GPU utilization metric to avoid scraping full per-process details for high-cardinality nodes (owner: alex.w)
- modify alerting to fire on scrape gaps, not only on raw node health (owner: sam)

priya: creating PR with these changes. small snippet for scrape buffering config to include in prometheus operator values:
```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://longterm-tsdb.example/api/v1/write
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 1000
      capacity: 50000
      max_shards: 10
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'gpu_exporter'
    scrape_interval: 30s
    scrape_timeout: 15s
```
jorge: I'll prototype a lightweight push gateway for `nvidia-smi` heartbeats that runs as a daemonset with local cache on node. will include exponential backoff for network blips
emily: adding incident note to status page and notifying enterprise contacts. drafting message: "We are experiencing degraded capacity in us-west-2; failover to us-east-1 in progress; observability gaps temporarily affected troubleshooting. We'll share postmortem"
alex.w: small follow-up: add a synthetic end-to-end eval that runs model latency check against each region every 5m. we had no synthetic that checks GPUs specifically, only API-level checks
sam: cost/finance note — keep logs of extra tokens served during failover window, we'll need to credit affected customers if SLA threshold breached
priya: logging follow-up: reduce Loki ingestion rate for low-value logs during incident so ingesters don't OOM; snapshot existing logs required for postmortem
jorge: I've opened the PR for pushgateway prototype and the daemonset image; patch includes local retention of 10m and backfill script to push on reconnect
alex.w: timeline notes to add to postmortem: 14:02 - initial node flapping, 14:06 - prometheus operator OOM, 14:10 - first scrape gaps, 14:18 - restart replica 1, 14:28 - partial metrics restored, 14:35 - traffic shift begun, 14:50 - synthetic probes added, 15:12 - observability baseline fixes PR opened
emily: we're capturing action items in the incident board. i'll assign P0 owners and set a 72h SLA for the fixes to be shipped to staging
sam: 👍 will monitor cost delta and prepare an ops cost brief
alex.w: thanks all. after immediate triage, let's keep follow-ups in #incidents but move engineering work to eng-infra channel and the PRs. closing thread for updates, will update last_message_ts when we post the postmortem link
metrics-bot: NOTE: prometheus scrape success rate recovered to 94% after rolling restarts
infra-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: us-west-2 GPU instability reduced; monitoring has resumed but some Dedicated pools still in degraded capacity
alex.w: adding postmortem link when ready - will ping once published
